Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Rosa Quintero | DOB: 04/12/1951 | MRN: SYN-7002994
Date of service: 07/19/2025 | Dr. Ravi Langley, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
74-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2022, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: seasonal allergies, type 2 diabetes.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
She has taken weekly methotrexate (20 mg) for the better part of nine months, yet the small joints of both hands remain swollen.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 26.
Latent TB blood test and hepatitis B panel drawn on 07/06/2025 both came back clear.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
